issues.detail: PDF page 2 pairs 4.2 mt with 10,400 lb in the operating-weight note, while pages 3 and 7 identify 4.2 mt as 9,300 lb. The candidate uses the internally repeated 4.2 mt / 9,300 lb identity and preserves the page-2 label as a publication conflict.
Boom, stick, bucket linkage, cylinder anchor coordinates, slew bearing dimensions, and track-link geometry are not established by the admitted specification.
